subject: Aboard the colony ship ariadne, in the bay where the work is being done. Things are walking out of the stores Hamond keeps: a sack of seed, then a coil of cable, then another sack. Hamond has taken to joking about it at supper, loudly, and to taking the smallest bowl at the table, which isn't helping anything. Only these two officers are seen clearly; the other four at the table or on the ship are faceless: backs turned, in shadow or cut off by the frame.

notes: A crew photo for one pairing of this card's two leads. The incident is NOT the plain soc scene with faces swapped: this version of the card was rewritten for these two people (title: Short in the Stores). Read the version's text for what must be visible. Quiet, small stakes, nothing has gone wrong yet.
